title: Lost in the covered walkway: straight on
problem_line: The subject sprints into a covered walkway and vanishes from above. Where should the drone look?

beats.caption: The operator designates the volunteer in the red shirt; the drone follows on its own.
Sprint north up Oak Street, into the covered walkway.
Lost from above. Particles spread along the streets from where they vanished: one hypothesis, flowing straight ahead.
D12 picks P1, the street ahead: it covers the most of the belief the camera could see on arrival.
Where the camera looks and sees nobody, particles lose weight; under the roof they keep it. The drone watches the walkway's north end.
The subject comes out of the north end, into the camera's view. A person confirms the re-binding.

success_line: One hypothesis, straight ahead, found again: the route came from the belief, for a stated reason.
